edits.expected: And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of the LORD
edits.reason: Quick understanding is no longer transparent and can imply mental speed. The Hebrew uses a smell/delight idiom; the close NKJV comparison and lexical note support delight while preserving the verse’s focus on reverence for the LORD.
edits.replacement: And he will delight in the fear of the LORD
